findings.title: Arabic text cut off by its box
findings.message: 47px of this text is cut off at the bottom.
findings.fix: Let the box grow with min-width or min-height. If shortening is intended, add text-overflow: ellipsis and leave room for most of the text.
findings.snippet: المبلغ الإجمالي المستحق

findings.title: Arabic lines set too tight
findings.message: Line height is 1.40 on "سيتم إرسال إيصال الدفع الإلكتروني وتفاصي…".
findings.fix: Give Arabic body text a line height of about 1.6 to 1.8, for example :lang(ar) { line-height: 1.7 }.
